items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWER] I thought it was just Sam. No. What was Raymond playing?

ctx.x: I told the driver, get that quick. All the girls, you know, when they're coming out, man. Da da da. Come on. Read that, man. See, we read them, Sam. I guess what the mallet meant. What the mallet meant. Yeah. Nowadays, they used to stick them one side. It's the mallet on the cymbal. Yeah. One side of the mallet, you know. Like that, see.
Very familiar with my graduation at the West End Rule.
